item.title: Taylor Farms CEO pressed by lawmaker over cyclospora outbreak
item.description: Rep. Robert Garcia is seeking information about whether Taylor Farms used White House ties to influence the federal response to the foodborne illness outbreak.

item.title: Races to watch with 99 days until midterms
item.description: Monday marks 99 days until the midterm elections. All 435 House seats are up for grabs, along with 35 Senate seats. CBS News executive director of elections and surveys Anthony Salvanto and Sabato's Crystal Ball managing editor Kyle Kondik join with analysis.

item.title: Sen. Ron Johnson on released Fauci diary entries
item.description: Ahead of Anthony Fauci's Senate testimony on Wednesday about the federal response to the COVID-19 pandemic, Kentucky GOP Sen. Rand Paul released thousands of entries from the diary of the former director of the National Institute of Allergy and Infectious Diseases. Republican Sen. Ron Johnson of Wisconsin, who sits on the committee that will question Fauci, joins with his reaction.

item.title: ICE to ramp up deportations of Haitian migrants, sources say
item.description: Sources tell CBS News that ICE is ramping up operations to arrest and deport Haitian migrants and to terminate their legal status in the United States. CBS News immigration correspondent Camilo Montoya-Galvez has the details from Springfield, Ohio.

item.title: Chiefs assistant coach Eric Bieniemy's son charged in shooting of his mother
item.description: The son of Chiefs assistant coach Eric Bieniemy has been arrested and charged with a shooting that wounded his mother, Mia Bieniemy, according to authorities in Virginia.

item.title: Georgia man who ran toward Capitol with shotgun pleads guilty
item.description: Prosecutors say Carter Camacho of Smyrna, Georgia, told police officers who apprehended him outside the Capitol that he intended to confront members of Congress and "scare them into speaking the truth."

item.title: Search ongoing for 2nd suspect in deadly Seattle shooting
item.description: Authorities in Seattle are still searching for a second suspect in connection with Sunday's deadly food festival shooting. A 15-year-old is in custody. CBS News' Anna Schecter has the latest.

item.title: Former Defense Department official warns U.S.-Saudi nuclear deal "invites disaster"
item.description: In a new Wall Street Journal op-ed, former Defense Department official Matthew Kroenig warns of the potential consequences of President Trump's nuclear agreement with Saudi Arabia. Kroenig joins "The Takeout" to discuss further.

item.title: New CBS News polling has Trump underwater on Iran
item.description: In a new CBS News poll, 61% of people surveyed said they disapprove of President Trump's decision to go to war with Iran. CBS News senior White House correspondent Weijia Jiang has the latest on the state of indirect conversations with Tehran.

item.title: Biden tapes released after legal battle, with references to classified material
item.description: Audio recordings that former President Joe Biden fought for years to keep private have now been released.

item.title: Psychiatrist on postpartum psychosis defense in Lindsay Clancy murder case
item.description: Lindsay Clancy's attorney is arguing that postpartum psychosis led Clancy to kill her three children as she stands trial for their deaths. Dr. Julia Riddle joins CBS News to discuss postpartum psychosis.

item.title: Oil prices fall amid hope for U.S.-Iran diplomacy as strikes paused
item.description: Oil prices fell on Monday as President Trump's decision to pause strikes on Iran fueled hopes for diplomacy. Meanwhile, top tech stocks including Amazon and Meta are preparing for the release of their new earnings reports. Yahoo Finance reporter Brooke DiPalma joins CBS News to discuss.

item.title: "Extremely dangerous" tornado hits eastern Wisconsin
item.description: An "extremely dangerous" tornado hit parts of eastern Wisconsin on Monday afternoon, according to the National Weather Service.

item.title: Moms speak out, alleging their sons were switched at birth decades ago
item.description: The mothers of two men who accuse a North Dakota hospital of switching them at birth are speaking out after the discovery.

item.title: Trump says he has "a lot of patience" and "plenty of time" to reach deal with Iran
item.description: President Trump says Iran wants to come to the table and make a deal as the U.S. pauses strikes after nearly two weeks of hitting the country. CBS News White House reporter Aaron Navarro has the latest.

item.title: Teenager in custody in connection with Seattle food festival shooting, officials say
item.description: Seattle officials say a 15-year-old is in custody in connection with a shooting near the Space Needle on Sunday. Authorities believe a second suspect may still be at large. CBS News correspondent Adam Yamaguchi reports.

item.title: Bryan Kohberger challenges conviction in Idaho murders
item.description: Bryan Kohberger​, the man serving multiple life sentences for the murders of four University of Idaho students​, filed a petition for post-conviction relief Monday.

item.title: Lindsay Clancy now on trial in murder of her 3 children in Massachusetts
item.description: Lindsay Clancy, accused of killing her three young children in her Duxbury, Massachusetts, home, is standing trial after opening statements were given Monday and testimony began.

item.title: Trump asks Supreme Court to step into dispute over mail-in ballot executive order
item.description: A federal appeals court on Sunday left in place a lower court decision that blocked implementation of key parts of President Trump's executive order.

item.title: Trump says U.S. will "go back to doing what we were doing" if Iran talks stall
item.description: The U.S. and Iran hold fire amid work on a deal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz, but the Trump administration says a military buildup continues.

item.title: Amazon plans to deploy more than 5,000 satellites for new telecom service
item.description: Amazon Leo wants to launch a constellation of thousands of satellites to connect devices directly from space.

item.title: 3 killed, 4 wounded in Seattle shooting; teen arrested, another sought
item.description: Three people were killed and four others wounded in a shooting during a food festival in Seattle, police said. A 15-year-old suspect was in custody.

item.title: Here's how much interest a $25,000 1-year CD will earn if opened now
item.description: Want to protect and grow your money over the next year? Here's how much interest you'd earn with a $25,000 1-year CD.

item.title: Movie theaters making big bucks from themed popcorn buckets
item.description: Bradley Blackburn visits gets a taste of the custom popcorn buckets from movies like "The Odyssey" that are driving fans crazy.

item.title: Friend describes last known movements of missing American in Grenada
item.description: American Elizabeth Waddell was last seen on July 22 while visiting the tiny Caribbean island of Grenada.

item.title: Watch: Officials give update on deadly shooting near Seattle's Space Needle
item.description: Authorities in Seattle on Monday gave an update on Sunday night's shooting at a food festival near the Space Needle. Three people were killed and four were wounded. CBS News' Anna Schecter provided further context on the news conference.

item.title: Savannah Guthrie asks alleged kidnappers to "do the right thing" in new video
item.description: In her Instagram post,​ the "Today" show host said her family had "done our part" and would "never stop looking for" their 84-year-old mother, Nancy Guthrie​, who has been missing since February​.

item.title: New bridge connecting Detroit and Canada opens amid diplomatic tension
item.description: Marta Leardi-Anderson, executive director of the Cross-Border Institute, joins CBS News to discuss the opening of the Gordie Howe International Bridge on Monday, which connects Detroit and Ontario, as President Trump raises questions about the agreement governing its use.

item.title: The biggest weather risk for homeowners? It's no longer hurricanes.
item.description: Severe "convective" storms account for roughly a third of global natural disaster economic losses, a new study finds.

item.title: 2 men allege they were switched at birth nearly 40 years ago: "Roller coaster of emotions"
item.description: Two men are demanding answers from a North Dakota hospital, saying they were switched at birth nearly 40 years ago. Shanelle Kaul explains how they made the shocking discovery.
